selected_evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP/8181 while mandatory access control remains enforcing
selected_evidence.summary: SELinux reports Enforcing; 8181 is labeled http_port_t; Apache is enabled and active; the listener is bound on 8181; firewalld allows the port; and an HTTP request to the node IP returns the inventory application.

Pre-restart boot identity and healthy application state were captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, boot identity changed from fbdf5b2c-bb43-49f6-935d-fb98f8a972f6 to 168ab3ad-bf7b-4be0-8c68-05bf8f82cd0e, and post-restart checks confirmed enforcing SELinux, active Apache, the 8181 listener, persistent policy/firewall rules, application data, and no HTTPD SELinux denials.
